description: Metadata for public pages of the German Federal Office for Information Security (BSI) on www.bsi.bund.de about artificial intelligence. Each canonical URL was confirmed with one bounded GET. The catalog stores the title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page bodies are not stored. A missing date is unknown. Rights stay unknown unless the page states a reuse licence that allows copying. A public page is not a licence. runner_wired is false.
